# HardCall — 60ms 8kHz RTP Voice Barge-In Gateway & Simulator (https://hardcall.statementflow.win)

> Production PSTN/SIP telephony voice agent architecture achieving <60ms barge-in cutoff using raw 8kHz RTP, FreeSWITCH, SOXR VHQ resampling, and a 256-frame outbound ring buffer (0.16ms flush), compared against 900ms+ WebSocket/TCP trailing audio overlap.

## Interactive Demos
- **Free Browser Full-Duplex Barge-In Simulator**: Test adversarial voice interruption cadence directly in the browser with zero signup.
- **Interactive 52ms RTP vs 920ms WebSocket Audio Waveform Benchmark**: Hear and visualize real-time barge-in collision tails vs clean 52ms cutoff at https://hardcall.statementflow.win#enterprise-b2b.

## Open-Source Telephony Engineering Lab
- Python & Java runnable reference implementation: https://github.com/wangguode/ai-agent-voice/tree/main/01-voice-agent-rtp-bargein
